message: Dependabot reads its configuration only from the repository root, on the default branch, so it does not read web/.github/dependabot.yml in the project web; depcurfew apply configures Dependabot only at the repository root, and its delay there covers web too
fix: Move the updates entries of web/.github/dependabot.yml into the Dependabot configuration in the .github directory at the repository root, with directory: /web, then remove web/.github/dependabot.yml

message: Renovate reads its configuration only from the repository root, on the default branch, so it does not read web/renovate.json in the project web; depcurfew apply configures Renovate only at the repository root, and its delay there covers web too
fix: Move what web/renovate.json sets into the Renovate configuration file at the repository root, then remove web/renovate.json
